snippet.title: Croak and Solve | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Croak and Solve
Join Burst as he sorts out the chaos in Sorrentine. With your hips to the beat of jazz and a whole lot of bad luck, you'll have to dive into this fun pixel art world with RPG elements, to solve your adventures in the purest style of the best detectives who are now legends.
